*F-CGKA* (Continuous group key agreement) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an emerging formulation, still an active area of research.

*References:*

- Alwen et al. [*Security analysis and improvements for the IETF MLS standard for group messaging*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2019/1189). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2020, 2020.
